verdict.rationale: Convex's pricing page lists "Daily backups" as a feature, which is first-party evidence of automated backups. Nothing in the pack documents point-in-time recovery, the restore workflow, or retention. The `npx convex import` command is a data-import tool, not backup/recovery, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: point-in-time recovery, documented restore procedure, backup retention/frequency details beyond a pricing bullet, independent or hands-on corroboration.
